messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: GPU pool 'west-eu-prod-gpus' at 96% allocation. Autoscaler failing to add nodes (scale_limit=48). Queue growth detected. High-priority queue length 482 -> triggering page to oncall-sre :rotating_light:
oncall-sre: acked. I'm looking. Can someone pull the queue metrics and recent scale events?
anika: pulling metrics now. Grafana shows sustained enqueue rate spike starting ~12:04UTC; CPU on allocator pods low, but placement failures spiking.
leo: seeing repeated placement errors in scheduler logs: "failed to allocate MIG slice: no contiguous chunk matching size 1g. fragmentation=high"
omar: that matches the allocator traces I grabbed. Pasting tail: ```2026-03-15T12:10:23Z ERROR placement.go:412 failed place task t-84: MIGSliceUnavailable capacity=0 required=1g fragmentation=0.76```
sylvia: customer impact? Any 5xx or customer-facing timeouts?
support-lead: support dashboard shows elevated 504s for inference endpoints across multiple tenants starting 12:08UTC. Affected: ~6 customers, 2 with >10% error rate. We opened CS tickets for the top 3.
oncall-sre: ok triage plan: 1) pause non-critical batch jobs, 2) temporarily increase autoscale limit to 64 if possible, 3) begin manual repack if needed, 4) if still stuck, evict low-priority jobs. Assigning roles: leo -> logs & repack; anika -> autoscale limit & metrics; omar -> evictions; sylvia -> customer comms.
anika: trying to bump scale limit: API call to control-plane returned 403: "scale_limit change denied: quota_ownership_mismatch". Looks like dedicated capacity guard. Opening console, contacting infra-admins.
leo: starting a conservative repack dry-run to estimate move cost. Command: `./bin/allocator simulate-repack --pool west-eu-prod-gpus --strategy merge-small-mig` Output: estimated displacement 28 pods, 14 nodes touched, best-case latency reduction ~120ms.
omar: while repack runs, I can evict batch jobs from priority=low. Executing: `kubectl label jobs batch/* eviction=eligible && ./evictor --pool west-eu-prod-gpus --policy low-prio`
sylvia: posting proactive note in #general and pings to affected CSMs. Copying templated message: "We're investigating increased inference errors in west-eu region. Working on autoscale and placement; short-term throttling expected."
incident-bot: NOTE: autoscaler reported 5 consecutive scale attempts failed due to "insufficient MIG contiguous slices". Fallback behavior: throttle new requests to 30rps for affected routes.
anika: infra-admins responded: cluster-level quota prevents raising reserved capacity without approval. They suggested temporary emergency increase via admin API if SRE execs OK. Need approval.
oncall-sre: paged exec oncall (sre-exec): @sre-exec can we get emergency capacity lift for west-eu pool? This is causing customer impact.
sre-exec: on it, approving temporary increase to 60 for 30m. Runbook step initiated.
anika: applied scale_limit=60. Triggering autoscaler cooldown reset. `POST /admin/allocations/reset-cooldown pool=west-eu-prod-gpus` returned 200. Autoscaler started provisioning 4 nodes.
leo: new nodes came up but placement still failing on a subset due to MIG fragmentation: nodes show free but no single 1g slice contiguous. Repack dry-run now looks like it needs migration of larger VMs.
omar: starting targeted evictions on low-pri pods to free contiguous blocks. Evicted 35 batch pods, freed ~3 contiguous MIG slices. Monitoring.
incident-bot: Queue length falling 482 -> 210 over 6m. Throttle lowering to 60rps.
sylvia: customer update sent: "We've applied emergency scaling and are rerouting jobs; you may see transient errors while we stabilize. ETA ~30m."
support-lead: CS indicates two customers still seeing elevated errors; one requested SLA credit assessment. Logged for later.
anika: autoscaler successfully placed 3 pending tasks onto newly provisioned nodes, overall utilization back to 82%. But fragmentation alerts persist. Need long-term fix: change MIG sizing policy and repack schedule.
leo: attaching snippet of placement debug: ```node-47: slices=[0.25g,0.5g,0.25g] node-48: slices=[1g,0.5g] request=1g -> chose node-48 ok; node-49: slices=[0.5g,0.5g] request=1g -> fail``` Explains inability to pack.
omar: proposed immediate mitigation: enable emergency binpack mode that consolidates small slices by evicting selected low-impact pods to form larger contiguous slices, then auto-restore. Requires brief eviction window. Approve?
oncall-sre: approve for 15m window. Execute `./allocator binpack --pool west-eu-prod-gpus --window 15m --impact low`
anika: running binpack; estimated down-time for evicted pods ~20-45s each. Kicking off now.
incident-bot: binpack progress: 14/20 nodes consolidated. Fragmentation metric dropped 0.76 -> 0.12.
leo: placement success rate increasing. Queue length now 48. Latency 95p back to pre-incident.
sylvia: sending update to customers: "Issue mitigated; we're completing cleanup and will follow up with a root cause and timeline for permanent changes."
support-lead: opening follow-up tickets: 1) change default MIG sizes for west-eu, 2) add automated periodic repack, 3) review autoscaler policy for quota gating. Owners assigned.
oncall-sre: quick post-incident notes: - Incident declared SEV2 - Start 2026-03-15T12:04Z - Full mitigation at 12:40Z - Impact: transient 504s for 6 customers, 2 customers >10% errors, no data loss. - Actions taken: emergency scale limit bump, low-priority evictions, binpack consolidation, repack dry-run. - Next: schedule follow-up RFC for MIG sizing change.
sre-exec: thanks team. Also please prepare cost/retro for emergency scale lift and document approval flow so we can avoid manual unblock next time.
anika: I'll own the RFC for automatic emergency scale policy and repack cadence.
leo: I'll draft scripts to run simulated repack during low-traffic windows and add canary checks.
omar: I'll add improved eviction scoring to minimize customer impact.
sylvia: assigning postmortem to anika, leo, omar. Draft due EOD tomorrow.
incident-bot: Incident state: mitigated -> monitoring. Auto-close timer set for 72h.
support-lead: closing loop with CS contacts. If any customers escalate, ping me directly. :white_check_mark:
